supplements.title: Physicochemical characterization and anticancer potential of Ficus deltoidea-silver nanoparticles (FD-AgNPs) on HeLa cells: Evidence from apoptosis and proliferation assays.
supplements.summary: Silver nanoparticles made from Ficus deltoidea plant extract killed cervical cancer cells by triggering apoptosis and stopping cell growth.

supplements.title: Atractylon induces autophagy-dependent apoptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells via inhibition of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
supplements.summary: Atractylon kills liver cancer cells by triggering autophagy and cell death through blocking a key growth pathway.

supplements.title: Magnoliae flos Overcomes EGFR-TKI Resistance in NSCLC by Enhancing EGFR Ubiquitination.
supplements.summary: Magnoliae flos overcomes lung cancer resistance to standard drugs by breaking down EGFR proteins through a natural degradation process.

supplements.title: Mechanisms of Antibreast Cancer Activity of Terpenoids from the Fruiting Body of Antrodia cinnamomea in Cellular and Mice Models.
supplements.summary: Terpenoids from medicinal fungus Antrodia cinnamomea effectively killed drug-resistant triple-negative breast cancer cells by triggering cell death pathways.

supplements.title: EVs-Mediated Intracardiac Crosstalk Mitigates Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity.
supplements.summary: Exercise-derived extracellular vesicles protect heart cells from doxorubicin chemotherapy damage through specific molecular cargo called piRNAs.

supplements.title: Pueraria montana var. lobata Root Extract Alleviates Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease by Increasing Mitochondrial β-Oxidation and Mitochondrial-Peroxisome Contact.
supplements.summary: Kudzu plant extract reduces liver fat disease by boosting cellular fat-burning and improving communication between mitochondria and peroxisomes.

supplements.title: Molecular Docking and Anticancerous Activity of Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles Synthesized From Fruits of Prunus nepalensis Extract.
supplements.summary: Zinc oxide nanoparticles from Prunus nepalensis fruit extract effectively killed breast cancer cells by triggering apoptosis and activating tumor-suppressing genes.

supplements.title: Erianin facilitates pyroptosis in endometrial cancer via targeting m6A reader YTHDF1.
supplements.summary: Erianin, a natural compound, kills endometrial cancer cells by triggering pyroptosis through targeting the YTHDF1 protein.

supplements.title: Impact of vitamin D plasma levels on in vitro natural killer cell cytotoxicity against non-small cell lung carcinoma in the presence of nivolumab.
supplements.summary: Adequate vitamin D levels enhance natural killer cell effectiveness against lung cancer when combined with immunotherapy, particularly in high PD-L1 tumors.

supplements.title: Myricetin alleviates testosterone-induced benign prostatic hyperplasia by attenuating inflammation, oxidative stress, apoptosis and androgen signaling.
supplements.summary: Myricetin, a plant compound, reduces prostate enlargement in rats by decreasing inflammation, oxidative stress, and hormone signaling.

supplements.title: Multifaceted bioactivity of brown seaweed-derived fucoidan from the Indian Coastline: A natural health product candidate.
supplements.summary: Fucoidan from Indian brown seaweed shows promise as a natural compound with antioxidant, antidiabetic, and breast cancer cell-killing properties.

supplements.title: Comparative Evaluation of the Protective Activity of Dibornol and Prostagenin in a Model of DNA Damage in Rat Testicular Tissue Cells.
supplements.summary: Two antioxidant compounds, dibornol and prostagenin, both effectively reduced DNA damage in rat testicular cells, with prostagenin showing superior antioxidant protection.

supplements.title: Tridax procumbens promotes apoptosis and suppresses markers of proliferation, growth, and metastasis in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cells.
supplements.summary: Tridax procumbens extract kills pancreatic cancer cells by triggering apoptosis while remaining safe for normal pancreatic tissue.

supplements.title: Pomegranate Oil Nanoemulsion as a Nanotherapeutic Strategy Against Breast and Colon Cancer: Induction of Apoptosis and Inhibition of Cell Migration.
supplements.summary: Pomegranate oil nanoemulsion kills breast and colon cancer cells while preventing their spread.

supplements.title: Phytochemicals and callus suspension culture as cancer therapeutics.
supplements.summary: Plant-derived compounds from lab-grown callus cultures show promise as less-toxic cancer treatments by triggering cancer cell death through multiple mechanisms.

off_label.title: DJ-1 inhibition reshapes tumor microenvironment and potentiates immune checkpoint inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Blocking DJ-1 protein reprograms immune cells to enhance cancer immunotherapy effectiveness in resistant patients.

off_label.title: Pharmacological activation of WASp potentiates macrophage phagocytosis and enhances ibrutinib efficacy against mouse models of brain tumors.
off_label.summary: Activating WASp protein in immune cells restores their ability to kill brain tumor cells, improving the effectiveness of ibrutinib treatment.

off_label.title: Molecular and Cell Biological Characterization of Patient-Derived Head and Neck Squamous Carcinoma Cell Lines.
off_label.summary: Patient-derived head and neck cancer cells reveal specific genetic changes that could guide personalized treatment approaches.

off_label.title: 8-Aminoguanine protects against paclitaxel-induced neural degeneration and mechanical allodynia.
off_label.summary: Drug 8-aminoguanine prevents nerve damage and pain from paclitaxel chemotherapy by blocking an enzyme that damages nerve cells.

off_label.title: Leveraging a Multienzymes-Mimicking Nanozyme to Overcome CDK4/6 Inhibitor Resistance and Achieve Drug Repurposing in Oesophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
off_label.summary: A nanoparticle combined with CDK4/6 inhibitors overcomes drug resistance in esophageal cancer by triggering cell death pathways.

off_label.title: CSF3R signalling beyond granulopoiesis: new paradigms in female reproductive biology.
off_label.summary: CSF3R protein signaling promotes ovarian and endometrial cancer growth; blocking this pathway may offer new treatment options.

off_label.title: Understanding single stranded DNA gaps: from formation to fate.
off_label.summary: Single-stranded DNA gaps could help predict cancer treatment response and guide personalized therapy strategies by identifying drug resistance mechanisms.

off_label.title: Androgen Receptor-Induced Lactoferrin Accelerates Prostate Tumorigenesis Through Modulating Ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: Lactoferrin, controlled by androgen receptor, protects prostate cancer cells from iron-induced death, offering a new treatment target.

off_label.title: NQO1-Mediated Anoikis Resistance and Immune Evasion Define a High-Risk Multi-Omic Subtype for Precision Management of T1 High-Grade Bladder Cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified a high-risk bladder cancer subtype driven by NQO1 protein, enabling better treatment selection between surgery and bladder preservation.

off_label.title: Leveraging Kinase Drugs for Neurosciences: Discovery of Selective, CNS-Penetrant Reversible Bruton's Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors as Therapeutics for Neuroinflammation.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a brain-penetrating BTK inhibitor for neuroinflammation, but discovered dose-limiting toxicity when achieving CNS efficacy.

off_label.title: Proteasome Inhibitor-Induced Cytotoxic Mechanisms in Canine Pulmonary Adenocarcinoma Cell Lines.
off_label.summary: Proteasome inhibitors kill canine lung cancer cells and show promise when combined with carboplatin chemotherapy.

off_label.title: A Phase 1b Study of Gilteritinib in Participants With Locally Advanced or Metastatic NSCLC With ALK Rearrangement After Prior Treatment With an ALK Inhibitor
off_label.summary: Gilteritinib, an approved leukemia drug, is tested as a potential treatment for lung cancer patients who stopped responding to standard ALK inhibitor therapy.

off_label.title: Montelukast attenuates diclofenac sodium-induced cardiotoxicity in male rats via targeting Wnt/β-catenin pathway.
off_label.summary: Montelukast protects rat hearts from diclofenac-induced damage by blocking the Wnt/β-catenin pathway, reducing inflammation and cell death.

off_label.title: ECN Coated with Met Can Inhibit PD-L1 Expression in Tumor Cells and Enhance Immune-Mediated Antitumor Effects in CT26 Cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin-coated bacteria reduce immune evasion in colon cancer by blocking PD-L1 and boosting immune cell infiltration.

off_label.title: Protective effect of H1 Antihistamine against Lung Cancer in Patients with Allergic Diseases: A Global Federated Health Network Analysis.
off_label.summary: H1 antihistamines appear to reduce lung cancer risk in patients with allergic diseases like asthma and allergic rhinitis.

biomarkers.title: Telomere damage enhances immunogenicity of neuroblastoma and accelerates response to anti-PD-L1 treatment.
biomarkers.summary: Damaging telomeres in neuroblastoma tumors boosts immune response and significantly improves effectiveness of immunotherapy treatment.

biomarkers.title: Fecal tryptophan metabolism predicts the development of infant eczema: a prospective longitudinal study.
biomarkers.summary: Infants with altered gut bacteria tryptophan metabolism show distinct patterns predicting early or late eczema development, with specific metabolites as potential biomarkers.

biomarkers.title: The distinct roles of Negativicoccus and Fusobacterium in proximal- and late-onset colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Two gut bacteria drive different colorectal cancer types: Negativicoccus promotes early tumors through inflammation, while Fusobacterium drives late-onset cancers through cell migration.

biomarkers.title: Migrasomes: new communicators between cells.
biomarkers.summary: Migrasomes, newly discovered cell structures, show promise as biomarkers and therapeutic targets for treating multiple cancer types including glioma and pancreatic cancer.

biomarkers.title: Spatial multiomics profiling reveals ZFP36-mediated immunometabolic reprogramming in bladder cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking ZFP36 protein in bladder cancer enhances immune cell activation and improves anti-PD-1 immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: STAG2 loss amplifies EWS-FLI1-driven microsatellite enhancer activity promoting Ewing sarcoma aggressiveness.
biomarkers.summary: STAG2 loss in Ewing sarcoma reprograms cancer-driving EWS-FLI1 protein to activate more aggressive tumor genes.

biomarkers.title: Selective depletion of virus-specific CD8 T cells from the liver after PD-1 therapy with Fc-intact antibody during chronic infection.
biomarkers.summary: PD-1 antibodies with intact Fc regions unexpectedly depleted cancer-fighting CD8 T cells in the liver, reducing therapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: DJ-1 inhibition reshapes tumor microenvironment and potentiates immune checkpoint inhibitors.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking DJ-1 protein reprograms immune cells to enhance cancer immunotherapy effectiveness in resistant patients.

biomarkers.title: CD69 regulates the tissue dynamics of epigenetically imprinted memory CD4+ T cells.
biomarkers.summary: CD69 controls whether immune cells stay in lung tissue or recirculate, potentially spreading inflammation to other body areas in chronic diseases.

biomarkers.title: Setidegrasib in Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer and Pancreatic Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Setidegrasib, a new drug, directly targets the KRAS G12D mutation in lung and pancreatic cancers, offering the first approved therapy for this common genetic variant.

biomarkers.title: Physicochemical characterization and anticancer potential of Ficus deltoidea-silver nanoparticles (FD-AgNPs) on HeLa cells: Evidence from apoptosis and proliferation assays.
biomarkers.summary: Silver nanoparticles made from Ficus deltoidea plant extract killed cervical cancer cells by triggering apoptosis and stopping cell growth.

biomarkers.title: Interpretable prognostic modeling of glioblastoma using cross-cohort transcriptome integration and machine learning approaches.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a 22-gene signature that accurately predicts glioblastoma survival and identifies immune profiles to guide personalized treatment decisions.

biomarkers.title: Atractylon induces autophagy-dependent apoptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells via inhibition of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Atractylon kills liver cancer cells by triggering autophagy and cell death through blocking a key growth pathway.

biomarkers.title: Protein phosphatase 6 protects hepatocytes from endoplasmic reticulum and oxidative stress by suppressing Akt/mTOR signaling.
biomarkers.summary: PP6 protein protects liver cells by controlling stress pathways; its loss causes liver damage through excessive Akt/mTOR activation.

biomarkers.title: Mapping metastatic potential through cytoskeletal remodeling: A mechanobiology-based multi-cancer analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified five genes controlling cell structure that predict cancer metastasis potential across breast, pancreatic, and brain tumors.

trials.title: Telomere damage enhances immunogenicity of neuroblastoma and accelerates response to anti-PD-L1 treatment.
trials.summary: Damaging telomeres in neuroblastoma tumors boosts immune response and significantly improves effectiveness of immunotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Spatial multiomics profiling reveals ZFP36-mediated immunometabolic reprogramming in bladder cancer.
trials.summary: Blocking ZFP36 protein in bladder cancer enhances immune cell activation and improves anti-PD-1 immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: Selective depletion of virus-specific CD8 T cells from the liver after PD-1 therapy with Fc-intact antibody during chronic infection.
trials.summary: PD-1 antibodies with intact Fc regions unexpectedly depleted cancer-fighting CD8 T cells in the liver, reducing therapy effectiveness.

trials.title: DJ-1 inhibition reshapes tumor microenvironment and potentiates immune checkpoint inhibitors.
trials.summary: Blocking DJ-1 protein reprograms immune cells to enhance cancer immunotherapy effectiveness in resistant patients.

trials.title: Setidegrasib in Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer and Pancreatic Cancer.
trials.summary: Setidegrasib, a new drug, directly targets the KRAS G12D mutation in lung and pancreatic cancers, offering the first approved therapy for this common genetic variant.

trials.title: Hierarchical Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework-8@Au Cluster Nanocarriers for In Situ Chimeric Antigen Receptor Macrophage Programming and Immunotherapy in Prostate Cancer.
trials.summary: Nanoparticles deliver cancer-fighting genes directly to immune cells in prostate tumors, achieving 95% tumor growth inhibition in mice.

trials.title: Neoadjuvant and adjuvant nivolumab associated with irreversible electroporation in patients with BCLC a hepatocellular carcinoma and high risk of recurrence (NIVOLEP trial).
trials.summary: Combining immunotherapy with a specialized ablation technique reduced one-year recurrence rates in difficult-to-treat liver cancer patients.

trials.title: Castration Resistance Accelerates Prostate Cancer Kinetics.
trials.summary: Prostate cancer grows faster after developing resistance to castration therapy, according to a study measuring tumor progression rates.

trials.title: Genomic Prostate Score (GPS) as a Prognostic Biomarker in Patients With Localized Prostate Cancer Undergoing Focal Therapy.
trials.summary: A genetic test called GPS helps predict which prostate cancer patients will do well after focal therapy, a tissue-sparing treatment.

trials.title: Corticosteroid resistance is predetermined by early immune response dynamics at acute graft-versus-host disease onset.
trials.summary: Early immune cell dysfunction involving TNF-α and inflammasome activation predicts steroid resistance in acute graft-versus-host disease before treatment begins.

trials.title: Phase 1/1b study of BCMA-targeting bispecific T-cell engager pavurutamab in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
trials.summary: Pavurutamab, a new immunotherapy targeting BCMA, achieved a 66% response rate in treatment-resistant multiple myeloma patients with manageable side effects.

trials.title: Digital and AI-enhanced psychosocial interventions in breast cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Digital and AI-based mental health programs help reduce stress and anxiety in breast cancer patients, improving their overall well-being.

trials.title: Clinical significance of circulatory microRNA-183_5p and 3651 in serum as novel potential diagnostic marker for gallbladder cancer.
trials.summary: Two blood-based molecules (miR-183_5p and miR-3651) show promise as non-invasive diagnostic markers for gallbladder cancer detection.

trials.title: Implications for Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy Omission in Patients with Early-Stage Node-Negative HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer Undergoing Mastectomy.
trials.summary: Skipping lymph node biopsies appears safe for early-stage hormone-positive breast cancer patients undergoing mastectomy, similar to breast-conserving surgery.

trials.title: Transitioning to adolescent and young adult or adult cancer survivorship care: A systematic review of contemporary guidelines and trials.
trials.summary: Cancer survivors transitioning from pediatric to adult care face fragmented services; studies show coordinated transition programs improve outcomes and satisfaction.

mind_body.title: Digital and AI-enhanced psychosocial interventions in breast cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Digital and AI-based mental health programs help reduce stress and anxiety in breast cancer patients, improving their overall well-being.

mind_body.title: Early repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for preventing chronic postoperative pain in older adults: a randomized clinical sub-study.
mind_body.summary: Early brain stimulation therapy reduced chronic pain after lung cancer surgery in older adults.

mind_body.title: Exploring the underlying structural mechanisms and whole-person perspectives on the desire for hastened death in patients with terminal cancer: A qualitative study.
mind_body.summary: Palliative care professionals identified structural factors driving terminal cancer patients' desire for hastened death.

mind_body.title: Development and validation of the questionnaire 'Spiritual Needs in Palliative Care' in Finnish.
mind_body.summary: Researchers created and tested a new Finnish questionnaire to help palliative care teams identify patients' spiritual and existential needs.

mind_body.title: A Qualitative Study of Strength, Hope, and Meaning: Multi-Stakeholder Perspectives on Spiritual Care for Breast Cancer.
mind_body.summary: Spiritual care helps breast cancer patients, families, and healthcare teams find strength, hope, and meaning throughout treatment.

mind_body.title: Structured Post-Operative Pain and Distress Treatment Intervention for Patients Undergoing Surgery for Intra-Abdominal Malignancies
mind_body.summary: Video-based coping strategies, including mindfulness techniques, may help reduce pain and distress in patients recovering from abdominal cancer surgery.

mind_body.title: Cultural Adaptation and Feasibility of an Inpatient Yoga Intervention for Patients Undergoing Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation in Tanzania, India, and the United States: A Study Protocol.
mind_body.summary: Researchers are testing a culturally adapted yoga program to help blood cancer transplant patients manage symptoms during hospitalization across Tanzania, India, and the United States.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of qigong on subjective cognitive function in cancer survivors: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Qigong may help improve thinking and memory problems in cancer survivors, according to a review of existing studies.

mind_body.title: Cortical thickness, surface area, and multisite pain: distinct patterns by sex in adolescence.
mind_body.summary: Researchers found sex-based differences in how adolescents' brain structure relates to experiencing pain at multiple body sites.

mind_body.title: The Central Qi theory in traditional Chinese medicine: Gut microbiota modulation as a strategic target for hepatocellular carcinoma therapy.
mind_body.summary: Traditional Chinese herbal medicine may improve quality of life and treatment tolerance in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma patients by modulating gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of mindfulness-based stress reduction in managing fatigue, anxiety, and depression among non-small cell lung cancer patients receiving surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy: A randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based stress reduction helped reduce fatigue, anxiety, and depression in lung cancer patients undergoing surgery and chemotherapy.

mind_body.title: Prevalence and severity of imposter phenomenon in consultant radiographers.
mind_body.summary: Study finds self-doubt feelings are common among consultant radiographers despite their proven competence and expertise.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture improves cognitive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms in breast cancer survivors: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture treatment improved cognitive function and mental health symptoms in breast cancer survivors in a pilot study.

mind_body.title: Supportive Care Interventions in Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Supportive care interventions like exercise, music, and stress management show promise for improving quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: The Effect of Yoga and Relaxation Techniques on Anxiety, Stress Levels, and Quality of Life in Parents of Children Diagnosed with Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Yoga and relaxation techniques significantly improve anxiety, stress, and quality of life in parents caring for children with cancer.
